CREATE VIEW cr_fields AS SELECT id,(v).b AS b,(items[1]).b AS first_b,((nested).v).b AS nested_b,(d).b AS domain_b FROM cr_rows; CREATE VIEW cr_mixed AS SELECT ('(8,eight)'::cr_pair).b AS x,('(9,nine)'::cr_other).b AS y; CREATE VIEW cr_scope AS WITH data AS(SELECT v AS x FROM cr_rows) SELECT (q.x).b AS b FROM (SELECT x FROM data) q; CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW cr_mat AS SELECT id,v,(v).b AS b FROM cr_rows; CREATE FUNCTION cr_pick(v cr_pair) RETURNS text LANGUAGE SQL RETURN (v).b; CREATE FUNCTION cr_late(v cr_pair) RETURNS text LANGUAGE SQL AS 'SELECT (v).b'; CREATE TABLE cr_defaults(v cr_pair DEFAULT '(7,seven)',b text DEFAULT ('(6,six)'::cr_pair).b); CREATE INDEX cr_idx ON cr_rows(((v).b)); CREATE TABLE cr_checks(v cr_pair CHECK ((v).b<>'bad'))
